Most disputes in India are resolved one of two ways: through the courts, on a timeline and under rules designed for every kind of case rather than any one kind, or through ad hoc arbitration or mediation, where the parties negotiate procedure from a blank page every time a disagreement arises. Adjudix was founded to offer a third option: a standing institution with the Adjudix Code of ADR Procedure, {0}, a panel of vetted specialists organized by dispute type, and a Training Institute that gives the next generation of arbitrators, conciliators, and mediators a defined path into the profession.
